grades.lower_bound_mechanism: QM–AM–GM applied to x and y+c, both inequalities squared out
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: asymptotic two-sided orbit sandwich (E1/E2 estimates) + downward bootstrap
grades.notes: Complete rigorous proof. Steps 1–2 derive f(f(y))=2f(y)−y and g=f−id≥0 via orbit APs. Part I verifies sufficiency for all c≥0, both inequalities. Steps 3–6: sandwich pins g(x)=d on a half-line, all positive gaps equal, bootstrap extends to all y>0; fixed-point case (c=0) handled. One garbled but harmless line in Step 3's upper bound.
